item.title: From the Darkness ~Injuu Genmu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RingerBell
  • 発売日: 2002-08-23
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: from The Darkness ～淫獣幻夢～
  • 英語名: From the Darkness Injuu Genmu

あらすじ

A collection of four stories featuring five girls:

  1. 「一ノ瀬と如月の秘密登場」

  2. 「岡本瞳～図書室にて～」

  3. 「藤沢弥生の体験」

  4. 「小早川里美～契約～」

They are ordinary girls, but they share one thing in common… their strong sexual desires.

Relationships with boyfriends, fantasies, lust, rape fantasies, and various other sexual desires.

A beast, sensing these mental waves, humiliates the women!

Is it a demon from the demon world, or a lustful beast from another realm…?
